question: What Windows app can turn a single photo into a 3D model without an NVIDIA GPU (AMD or CPU only)?

recommendations.name: Modelado (Windows desktop app)
recommendations.quote: Turns one photo of a single object into a textured mesh (TripoSR under the hood).

recommendations.name: Shape Studio by Hivemind (free)
recommendations.quote: Local image‑to‑3D studio with TripoSR and other pipelines; includes mesh tools and exports.

recommendations.name: Modly (open‑source desktop app)
recommendations.quote: Local image‑to‑3D (TRELLIS.2, Hunyuan3D, TripoSG) with GLB/OBJ/STL/PLY export.

recommendations.name: Reallusion Character Creator + Headshot 3 (plugin) — faces
recommendations.quote: Generates a fully rigged 3D head from a single photo inside Character Creator.

recommendations.name: FaceGen Artist (faces)
recommendations.quote: Creates a 3D face from one (or more) photos; exports for Daz/other tools.
